verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for an authenticator app that offers cloud sync, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows a choice between local-only use ('Use without an account') and syncing to a Google Account. Nothing documents choosing a storage region or residency, and the local-vs-cloud switch is an adjacent control, not the capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
